name: TOB Sunday School Points Ledger
description: One row per points movement in the Sunday School weekly rewards system — mirrors TOB Reward Ledger's idempotent shape exactly, but is a fully separate table/system per the app's own explicit requirement that the two reward systems never mix. Balance = sum(points) for a user; weekly totals = sum(points) where week_start = X. Every insert goes through truth_of_bible.sunday_school.engine.award(), which enforces dedupe_key uniqueness.

fields.label: Week Start
fields.description: Monday of the ISO week this was earned in — see engine._week_start(). Weeks are implicit, not a doctype.

fields.label: Source
fields.options:
Weekly Quiz
Sunday Goal
Complete Verse
Group Bonus
Faith Leader Exam
Redemption
Expired
Manual Adjustment

fields.label: Points
fields.description: Signed — can be negative for a manual correction.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Denormalized from the user's profile at award time, so a later group re-assignment never rewrites historical weekly totals.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Human label shown in the student's points history, e.g. "Weekly Bible Quiz — 92/100".

fields.label: Dedupe Key
fields.description: Prevents the same award being inserted twice (e.g. a retried request).
